Question: Has Elon Musk's story on Mars landing changed?
Today: 2026-09-27
Question type: drift (how their story or view changed over time)
Topics on record that match: mars-landing

Scores, all topic

data.answer:
Yes: Musk’s Mars landing story has shifted from missions starting in 2018, to uncrewed Starships in 2026, to saying SpaceX has shifted focus to a Moon city while Mars would take 20+ years.

In 2016 he said SpaceX would send a Mars mission with every opportunity “from 2018 onwards”; that did not happen. In 2024 he said “The first Starships to Mars will launch in 2 years,” with uncrewed landings in the 2026 window; that is still waiting on its deadline. In 2026 he said SpaceX had “shifted focus” to a self-growing Moon city in under 10 years, while Mars would take more than 20 years; that is also waiting on its deadline.
